examples.text: Was ihr sagt, ist meist wahr.
examples.en: What you say is usually true.
Most of the time we're friends.

examples.text: Am Wochenende bin ich meist zu Hause.
examples.en: I usually spend weekends at home.

examples.text: Er kommt zu Besprechungen meist zu spät.
examples.en: He tends to be late for meetings.
Tom spends most of his time surfing.
